propositions: Core must compare only canonical (local-vocabulary) shapes; vendor shapes cross core solely as opaque payloads produced/consumed at emission and ingestion boundaries via port calls.

All remaining Jira modules (outbound_fields, adf, acli, comment_limits, link differ, absence probe, rich-text codec) must physically relocate to adapters/jira/ and route through the Backend port interface.

Every core module (src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/*.py) must have zero direct imports of adapters.jira, no lazy-key literals referencing vendor adapters, and no by-path file loads of vendor siblings.
The outbound differ must canonicalize snapshots via InboundMapper, compare canonical relations, and build vendor payloads only via injected OutboundMapper at emission boundaries.

The scalar port surface (project/query_project/assert_env_ready/neutral BackendAssigneeNotFoundError) and the Backend registry (config.reconciler.backend selection) must route all transport construction and provider literals through the port.
